notes: Settings redesigned like a modern app: grouped sections (General, Storage, Support) with tidy rows and clear descriptions.
Every screen shows its name in the top bar, so you always know where you are, with a back arrow that appears when needed.
New Appearance toggles: compact lists and serif note titles, with modern switch controls.
Account page got a sync-server section: you can connect your own Supabase project if the built-in server is unavailable, or reset back to the built-in one.
Signing in now explains clearly when the server cannot be reached, instead of a raw fetch error.
Categories open on their own dedicated page.
Fixed the crash when turning off 'Show the floating pen'.
Select text in any PDF, tap 'Note down', and file the line in a category.
Loading screen on open, and the app always loads the newest version when online.
Account created and signed-in now show a popup confirmation instead of just a toast.
Capture modal auto-fills book/author/page from the reading context, auto-links to the active session.
Floating pen panel shows the current reading page title and page number.
Android: ReadingContextService captures foreground app context; MainActivity injects it into the WebView.
Margin notes indicator: pages with notes show a • marker; tapping filters the note list to that page.
Book timeline page filtering: review and list views now filter notes by page number. Go back clears the filter.
Store initialization fixed: app no longer hangs on loading screen when MarginaliaStore is unavailable.
Improved error handling: all async init failures now show proper toast messages instead of crashing.
Service worker cache clearing guidance: users can force refresh via F12 → Application → Clear site data
Full prompt.txt compliance: all 28 sections implemented including categories, quotes, timeline, margin notes, search, offline mode, multilingual support
